expected_issues.description:
isNil's list of nilable reflect.Kinds omits reflect.UnsafePointer, so a nil unsafe.Pointer value is not classified as nil and Nil/NotNil assertions misjudge it.

Provenance: fix PR #1319 (commit 9acc222).
